Front: What does 'w' mode mean in open()?
Back: Write mode; it overwrites the file.

Front: What does 'a' mode mean in open()?
Back: Append mode; it adds to the end of the file.

Front: Why use with open(...) as file?
Back: It automatically closes the file when the block ends.
